L01.drivers: Typical male proportions, slight soft belly, normal shoulder-to-hip ratio, straight legs, normal feet

L02.drivers: Average lean build, ordinary limb lengths and joint transitions

L03.drivers: Narrow, tubular trunk with little chest-to-hip taper in front, but profile shows a large rounded posterior back/shoulder mass and deep chest-back curvature; strongly sinuous leg profile with pronounced knee bulge and high calf swell; long thin forearms; segment relations unlike the human-variation bodies
limb_cues: high bulging calves with thin shins

L04.drivers: Slim but ordinary male body, normal proportions

L05.drivers: Massive shoulder/trapezius block with no visible neck taper, short squat legs with wide stance, huge plates of quadriceps, enormous forearms and hands, oversized broad feet; profile shows forward-thrust bent knee and heavy backward-set lower leg; overall ogre/troll-like organization, not merely a bodybuilder

L06.drivers: Ordinary slim body, slight female-leaning proportions, normal segment relations

L07.drivers: Average-to-broad shouldered male, slightly fuller thighs, normal structure

L08.drivers: Slightly heavier, with soft belly and prominent buttocks in profile, but within ordinary range

L10.drivers: Same body plan as L05: blocky trunk, massive shoulders/arms, huge hands, short heavy bent legs, oversized feet, forward-leaning, bent-kneed profile

L11.drivers: Same pattern as L03: narrow tubular front torso, large rounded upper-back/chest mass in profile, sinuous legs with prominent knee and high calf bulges, long thin arms
limb_cues: high calf swell over thin shins

L12.drivers: Ordinary male build, slightly broad, normal proportions

distinguishing_features: L05/L10 are enormously bulky and squat: blocky trunk, giant arms and hands, short thick bent legs, huge feet, forward-leaning. L03/L11 are slender, near-human silhouettes in front but differ in profile: rounded back/chest mass, narrow tubular waist, exaggerated knee and calf contours. The L03/L11 group is less certain; in front view it could pass for thin humans, and the call rests mostly on profile organization.
